description: Shows the prepaid balance's history, latest first. Entries cover the welcome credit, top-ups, refunds, adjustments, and the daily keyword-day and mention debits. Debits carry their UTC settlement day and cumulative units. Cursor pages, limit up to 100. Funds are added on the dashboard's billing page or with POST /v1/billing/top-ups.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page. Do not parse it.

limit.description: How many to return, 25 by default.
